name: CRM - Support Ticket Assignment

parameters.query: SELECT u.username, u.mattermost_user_id FROM crm_support_agents u WHERE u.tenant_id = $1 AND u.is_available = true ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_tickets WHERE assigned_to = u.username AND status != 'CLOSED') ASC LIMIT 1;
INSERT INTO crm_tickets (tenant_id, title, description, priority, customer_id, assigned_to, status, created_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,'OPEN',NOW()) RETURNING id;
